Findings across the three experiments
Conventional tasks: similar scores on IMDb/Yelp, with lower traditional inference latency.
MultiNLI: the tested pretrained Transformer shows a larger quality advantage.
Imbalance: TF-IDF + SVM has the largest F1 drop (77.8 pp).
DistilBERT retains the highest severe-condition F1 (0.7910).
Model choice depends on task semantics, latency constraints and minority-class requirements.
